maid_skill.ef_tlm.scythe_innate.desc:
§7┌ §fBasic Attack§r: The 1st, 3rd, and 5th hits apply §cCurse of Blood§r (20s) to the target.
§7├ If the target is immune to §cCurse of Blood§r, grant yourself §dBlood Blessing§r instead as an alternative for consumption.
§7├ §fDash Attack§r: On hit, absorbs 1 stack of §cCurse of Blood§r to grant §bDamage Reduction§r (15s), up to 4 stacks.
§7├ §fJump Attack§r: On hit, absorbs 1 stack of §cCurse of Blood§r to grant §eAttack Speed Boost§r (15s), up to 3 stacks.
§7├ §fSkill: Harvest§r: Unleashes 3 spinning attacks. Deals increased damage to §cCurse of Blood§r targets and absorbs 1 stack per hit,
§7│ converting it into energy while granting Super Armor and stacking §aAttack Boost§r (15s), up to 6 stacks.
§7├ §fSkill Energy§r: Attacks generate energy. §6When fully charged, blocking allows casting the enhanced skill§r:
§7│ §fSkill: Scarlet End§r: Unleashes a wide slash, clearing the target's §cCurse of Blood§r to deal bonus damage and restore HP based on stacks cleared.
